# Proposal

Build the proposal in one pass and show it to the person before anything is written.

### start

1. Read the request the person gave.
2. Draft one proposal from it.
3. Show the proposal and ask the person to accept or revise it.

- `accept`: go to `identifier`.
- `change`: go to `revise`.

### revise

1. Apply the change the person asked for.
2. Show the whole proposal again.

- `accept`: go to `identifier`.
- `change`: stay on `revise`.

The proposal keeps every part the person did not ask to change.

Each revision replaces the shown proposal; earlier drafts are not kept.

The person may revise as many times as they need.

No record is written while the proposal is being revised.

## Verification
- The proposal was shown before `identifier`.
- Each revision kept the parts the person did not change.
